data.name: Hyatt Place Santiago/Vitacura
data.address: Américo Vespucio Nte. 1597, 7630293 Vitacura, Región Metropolitana, Chile
data.description:
A 4-minute walk from the Museo de la Moda, this sleek hotel overlooking the Andes mountains is 4 km from Bicentenario Park and 3 km from shopping and a skyscraper at Costanera Center.
Relaxed rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, sofabeds and floor-to-ceiling windows, as well as minifridges, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Upgraded rooms add mountain views, while suites include separate living areas.
Amenities include a casual 24-hour restaurant and a cafe/bar. There's also a terrace and a heated indoor pool with city views, as well as a 24-hour gym. Breakfast and parking are available.
